name: agent_outbound_webhooks_parse_single_target
notes: Webhook target parse ladder (outbound_webhooks.c::ow_parse_single_target + ow_resolve_secret vs LIVE agent/outbound_webhooks.py::_parse_single_target). Harness is a rung-for-rung traced copy; the twin uses the LIVE _resolve_secret and DEFAULT/MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS so semantics are LIVE. KNOWN DIVERGENCES (excluded from walk): (1) LIVE filters events against hermes_cli.plugins.VALID_HOOKS and drops unknown names; the C port copies any string event — walk uses only valid hook names. (2) LIVE strips url/name/matcher values; C does not — walk uses unpadded literals. (3) secret_env pointing at a SET environment variable is excluded because wc_run cannot export env to both sides identically; only the unset-warning path is walked. Timeout clamp rungs B8/B9 are checked pre-clamp on both sides (C order).
